test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.

The food was not as delicious as we had expected.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, there is no grammatical error.
 
• All parts of the sentence are **correctly structured and appropriately used.**
 
• The sentence correctly **conveys **that the f**ood did not meet the expectations in terms of its deliciousness.**
 
• Therefore, the option indicating '**No error'** is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Always ensure subject-verb agreement in a sentence.
 
• Check for parallel structures when comparing or listing items in a sentence.
 
• Ensure correct use of tenses to maintain consistency throughout the sentence.
